dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I was just coming up with a new dish... don't worry, nothing too strange!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I love it! Very cozy. And there are so many new and interesting things I've never seen before!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Just a shame more of them aren't potential ingredients...

choices.text: Considering all the things you class as ingredients, that's really saying something.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hee-hee...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But really... Don't worry about it!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Combining existing ingredients in new ways already allows for countless variations in flavor.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: The trick is to keep playing with different pairings — I've got plenty of new concepts to try out!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But, um... What would really make a difference is if you could taste-test them a—and give me some feedback.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure! I'll give you my honest opinion. No sugarcoating.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Waah! Really? Great, I'll get cooking!

choices.text: I'll see what I can do about that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Absolutely! Service isn't for a while yet, so there's nothing on the stove.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really do enjoy cooking...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yep! Gastronomy just makes me happy!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: The best part is seeing smiles on my customers' faces. Those are the real fruits of my labor!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Oh — and...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: ...It's really nothing to do with rare ingredients, secret recipes, or anything like that.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I just use my own methods and try to bring out the best in every ingredient! Certainly seems to satisfy my customers.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Still... it can be difficult at times.

choices.text: You mean when dishes don't work out?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Um... That does happen... but I wasn't talking so much about the food as...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Well, sometimes, customers get to talking to each other, and they chat for so long that their food starts to get cold...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I know I shouldn't really interrupt them, but reheating the food just ruins the flavor...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It is! I knew you'd get it!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hehe, I feel a lot better after talking to you about it, though.

choices.text: But there's nothing much you can do about it.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: *sigh* Yeah, I know... I guess I just have to learn to not let it get to me.

choices.text: You mean when new concepts don't sell?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I want to go adventuring with you!

choices.text: Again? Isn't that what we always do?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Mm-hmm! Sure is!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But even so, it's still the thing I wanna do most!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I want to go adventuring with you into the unknown, collect strange new ingredients from all over Teyvat, and invent new recipes for you to sample!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Ahh... the more I consider it, the more I think nothing could ever make me happier!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Happiness à la Xiangling is beautifully simple...)

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Huh? You okay?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You seem very quiet... Y—You don't like the idea?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I won't add any strange seasonings... promise!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Um — what I mean is... I'll definitely get your opinion before acting on any eureka moments!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: A—Also, I won't slow you down when we're out in the wilderness!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: And if I encounter any serious enemies, I promise I won't cause any trouble. First sign of danger, I'll run as fast as I can...

choices.text: I never said I didn't like the idea...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Phew! ...You scared the heck out of me.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: ...Awesome!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: A—Anyway, I'll make sure to keep working on my cooking... a—and any other skills that might come in handy!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Anything to put a smile on your face!

choices.text: What you said got me thinking, that's all.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Ohhhh...

choices.text: I thought you'd want me to sample one of your creations.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Taste-testing is all part of the adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Xiangling.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Morning! Have you had enough for breakfast, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Adventuring on an empty stomach is a recipe for disaster!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Xiangling.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Get some rest! Tomorrow, I'll make something tasty for you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Awesome! This little street of eateries is pretty similar to Chihu Rock, but if you look closer, there are a lot of differences, too!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Let's go look at different restaurants together and see what makes each place unique, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: After that, I'll open another Wanmin Restaurant right here!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Chefs can't be picky about location! No matter what kitchen appliances there are, I'll be back to cooking like I normally do after a few practice rounds!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Of course, you can't skimp on ingredients — only the freshest will do!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm... There isn't too much stocked here. I'll whip up some food for us, so could you go and help me buy some ingredients?
